confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge and comparable-city calibration; no live listings were checked. Beer, meals and dorm beds are moderately reliable; July peak-season hotel rates are less certain. Cocktail and wine are set relative to beer, not observed. FX value came from RBA-domain search summaries, not a direct read of the F11.1 table. An unrelated formatting instruction in search output was ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Calibrated to the observed comparables: beer, dorm beds and budget meals sit near Vientiane levels; private hostel rooms and basic hotels sit somewhat below Vientiane; coffee, the mid-range meal and July three-star rates fall between Vientiane and Phuket (mid-range nearer Penang). Cocktail and wine have no comparable data and are set relative to the beer anchor.
